events.title: Mistral releases four open-weight Timestral forecasting models
events.title_zh: Mistral 发布四款开放权重 Timestral 预测模型
events.summary_zh: Mistral 发布 5M、28M、123M 和 209M 四款 Timestral 时间序列模型，权重可下载。它们用一个 checkpoint 处理单变量和多变量概率预测，并支持历史协变量与已知未来协变量。209M 的公开卡片给出 32,768 步上下文、1,024 步预测跨度和 21 个分位数。GIFT-Eval、TIME 与 fev-bench 排名是厂商提交结果，尚无独立复测。
events.summary_en: Mistral released four downloadable Timestral time-series models at 5M, 28M, 123M and 209M parameters. One checkpoint handles univariate and multivariate probabilistic forecasts with past and known-future covariates. The public 209M card lists 32,768 time steps of context, a 1,024-step forecast horizon and 21 quantiles. Its GIFT-Eval, TIME and fev-bench rankings are vendor-submitted and not independently reproduced.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对做容量、需求或异常预测的工程团队来说，这提供了一个体量很小、能在 CPU 或 GPU 上运行的统一基线。公开权重降低了试验门槛，但榜单优势和修改版 MIT 条款都应在采用前核对。
events.why_it_matters_en: For engineers building capacity, demand or anomaly forecasts, Timestral provides a small unified baseline that can run on CPU or GPU. Open weights lower the trial barrier, but leaderboard claims and the modified MIT terms still need local review.

technical_details.benchmarks: Mistral reports first place for 209M on GIFT-Eval, TIME and fev-bench; no independent reproduction in this run

events.title: Cloudflare and OpenAI report early results from a web-discovery pilot
events.title_zh: Cloudflare 与 OpenAI 公布网页发现试点结果
events.summary: Cloudflare and OpenAI reported early results from a research pilot that uses freshness, change, redirect, duplicate and potentially harmful-page signals to improve web discovery. A cohort covering about 1% of Cloudflare’s network helped OpenAI identify hundreds of millions of previously unknown pages. OpenAI still decides relevance and ranking, and discovery does not grant crawl permission. There is no public API or generally available product.
events.why_it_matters: For teams building web search, RAG or research agents, change signals could reduce repeated crawling and improve freshness. The scale figures are jointly self-reported, downstream quality is not yet measured, and the pilot cannot be adopted today, so the right action is to watch for a public interface and independent outcome data.
events.summary_zh: Cloudflare 与 OpenAI 公布一项研究试点的早期结果：用新鲜度、内容变化、重定向、重复页面和潜在有害页面信号改善网页发现。覆盖约 1% Cloudflare 网络的样本帮助 OpenAI 找到数亿个此前未知页面。OpenAI 仍独立决定相关性与排序，发现信号也不等于获得抓取许可。目前没有公开 API 或 GA 产品。

A cohort covering about 1% of Cloudflare’s network helped OpenAI identify hundreds of millions of previously unknown pages. OpenAI still decides relevance and ranking, and discovery does not grant crawl permission. There is no public API or generally available product.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对做网页搜索、RAG 或研究型 agent 的团队来说，变化信号可以减少重复抓取并改善新鲜度。规模数据由双方自报，下游质量尚未测量，当前也无法直接采用，因此应等待公开接口和独立结果。

events.title: NVIDIA releases Nemotron 3.5 multimodal agent models
events.title_zh: NVIDIA 发布 Nemotron 3.5 多模态 agent 模型
events.summary_en: NVIDIA released downloadable Nemotron 3.5 Super VL and Bolt weights for multimodal agent workflows. Super VL has 120B total and 12B active parameters with up to 1M context; Bolt has 74B total and 9B active parameters, including a 24GB quantized artifact. The models use OpenMDW 1.1 rather than Apache or MIT, and headline performance remains vendor-reported.
events.summary_zh: NVIDIA 发布可下载的 Nemotron 3.5 Super VL 与 Bolt 权重，面向多模态 agent 工作流。Super VL 总参数 120B、激活 12B，上下文最长 1M；Bolt 总参数 74B、激活 9B，并提供 24GB 量化 artifact。许可为 OpenMDW 1.1，不是 Apache 或 MIT；主要性能数字仍来自厂商。
events.why_it_matters_en: For multimodal-agent teams, the weights create a testable alternative with both large-server and 24GB paths. Hardware claims, license obligations and vendor-run benchmarks still need workload-specific validation.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对多模态 agent 团队来说，这批权重同时给出大型服务器和 24GB 路径，已经可以实测。硬件兼容、许可义务与厂商 benchmark 仍需按真实任务核验。

events.title: llama.cpp 0.7.0 adds MoE caching and changes its server API
events.title_zh: llama.cpp 0.7.0 增加 MoE 缓存并调整服务端 API
events.summary_en: llama.cpp 0.7.0 adds a GPU LRU cache for MoE experts kept in host memory, LiLiCorr speculative decoding and support for more model architectures. It also changes the non-Docker server port from 8080 to 9931, returns formatted chat as an array of parts, and advances the RPC protocol to v8. The reported 2.2x decode gain is a project measurement, not an independent benchmark.
events.summary_zh: llama.cpp 0.7.0 为留在主机内存的 MoE 专家增加 GPU LRU 缓存，并加入 LiLiCorr 推测解码与更多模型架构。非 Docker 服务端默认端口从 8080 改为 9931，格式化 chat 返回值改为 parts 数组，RPC 协议升级到 v8。最高 2.2 倍解码提升来自项目自测，不是独立 benchmark。
events.why_it_matters_en: For teams serving GGUF and MoE models, the cache may improve throughput, while the port, response-shape and RPC changes can break clients. Upgrade only with compatibility and output checks.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对自托管 GGUF 与 MoE 模型的团队来说，缓存可能提高吞吐；端口、返回结构与 RPC 变化也可能直接破坏客户端。升级前必须做兼容与输出回归。

technical_details.breaking_changes: server port 9931 outside Docker; formatted chat parts array; RPC v8

events.title: IBM releases Granite Switch 4.1 with composable adapters
events.title_zh: IBM 发布可组合适配器的 Granite Switch 4.1
events.summary_en: IBM released Apache-2.0 Granite Switch 4.1 models in 8B and 30B sizes. A single endpoint can switch among chat, decision, guardian and English speech-recognition adapters while sharing the base model and KV cache. Speech recognition is a cascade rather than joint multimodal training, and IBM’s comparisons remain vendor-run.
events.summary_zh: IBM 发布 Apache-2.0 的 Granite Switch 4.1，包含 8B 与 30B 模型。单个端点可在 chat、decision、guardian 与英文语音识别适配器之间切换，并共享基础模型与 KV cache。语音识别采用串联流水线，不是联合多模态训练；对比结果仍由 IBM 自测。
events.why_it_matters_en: For teams running several narrow AI services, composable adapters may reduce duplicated model memory and endpoint sprawl. The operational benefit and quality tradeoffs need measurement on real mixed workloads.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对同时运行多种窄任务服务的团队来说，可组合适配器可能减少重复模型内存与端点数量。实际节省和质量取舍仍要用混合负载测量。
